cards.front: On a coordinate graph, which axis is the vertical one?

options.explanation: The y-axis runs vertically, with y-values increasing upwards and decreasing downwards from the origin.
The x-axis is the horizontal axis, not the vertical one. The vertical axis is the y-axis, which displays y-coordinates.
The origin is the point where the two axes intersect, rather than an axis itself. The vertical axis is the y-axis.
A coordinate is a value or ordered pair used to locate a point, not the name of an axis. The vertical axis is the y-axis.
